verdict.rationale: Cake documents board sign-offs and e-signing through automated flows for stock option grants, plus digital signing in its SAFE and convertible raise workflow, so board approval routing for e-signature is covered in at least those contexts. Nothing shows general board consents or stockholder approvals being drafted, or signed approvals being archived against the transactions they authorize. Missing for 10: board consent and stockholder resolution drafting/templates, stockholder approval workflows, archiving of signed consents linked to specific transactions, governance beyond option grants and raises, independent corroboration.
